texts: On day 410 of Year 2, a gust of wind extinguished a lantern on the Middle Row in the evening.
Marra Tallowhand saw the gust from her station.
Marra Tallowhand walked to the lantern.
Marra Tallowhand relit the lantern within the hour.
The lantern was not at the Sunken Cove.
The Council recorded the incident as a minor weather event.
Marra Tallowhand recommended that the Council issue extra mire-essence to the wind-exposed lanterns of the Cliff Path.
The Council took the recommendation under advisement.

q1_issues.issue: "record" is an act, not a stative psych/perception verb, so its transitive subject must be Agent, not Experiencer.
The direct object of "recorded the incident" gets no role atom on the record event — its slot is taken by a sealed proposition, and sealing is licensed only for a finite clausal complement.

"No wraith emerged" carries the explicit quantifier "no", which routes to the strength-0 distributing rule plus a mandatory (QuantifierPhrase wraith emerge "no") companion; the parse uses a single-witness denial bundle and emits no companion, collapsing quantifier-none into plain "a wraith did not emerge".
"within the hour" in sentence 4 is dropped entirely, so the relighting is asserted with no temporal bound at all.
"relit" is lemmatized to `light` with an added (Again …) tag, stripping a derivational prefix that the lemmatization rule says to keep (inflection only, never derivation).

q2_gaps: classificatory "V NP as NP/ADJ" secondary predicate ("recorded the incident as a minor weather event") — not a resultative (nothing changes) and not a depictive; no licensed carrier for the as-phrase
forward bounded window ("within the hour", "within two days") — WithinLast is backward-only, TimeAtMost needs a time term, and BeforeBy states an exact gap rather than a bound
prefixal derivation on a verb ("relit", "reopen") — the instruction set does not say whether the lemma is `relight` or `light` + (Again …)
quantity/portion of-phrase ("a gust of wind", the "a cup of water" case) — explicitly excluded from Possession and not a stated-proportion partitive, so no head is assigned
mandative subjunctive complement ("recommended that the Council issue …") — sealed as a plain proposition, and the directive force has no carrier (Directive/Forbid are imperative-only)

a definite superordinate NP anaphoric to a previously described event ("the incident" for the whole lantern episode) — the anaphoric-definite rule covers re-mention of a same-class witness, not a summary label
ordinal day-of-year in a non-Gregorian calendar ("day 410 of Year 2") — (Day n) is defined as the day slot of a calendar date, so (Day 410) overloads it
review.notes: Coreference across the passage is handled well (the lantern, the gust, and "the recommendation" → the recommend event), as is the sealed recommendation, whose Possession restrictor and per-member wind_exposed rule correctly stay inside the seal while the group typing, the Cliff Path name and the mire_essence genus project. The negated position atom (Past (LocatedIn …)) at strength 0.0 is also the right shape.

issues.reason: Thematic roles moves a transitive subject off Agent only for possession and STATIVE psych/perception, and "record" passes the progressive test ("is recording"), so the Council is an Agent; the Experiencer licence holds "exactly when the complement seals", which an entity object plus an as-phrase does not.

Sealing under Theme is "only for a finite clausal complement", and by using the slot for a sealed small clause the parse leaves the record event with no role atom for its stated direct object, so "what did the Council record?" cannot bind the incident.

The generic rule route is blocked in a dated one-off clause — "a bare plural in an episodic clause is a specific set, not a generic ... the generic rule route needs a genuinely generic clause" — so the strength-0 bundle with the indefinite subject inside is exactly the Negation (events) shape, and with no quantified range in the parse the companion is barred by "never a range that appears nowhere else in the parse"; the rule form would instead assert the false kind-level claim that no wraith ever emerges.

No head carries a forward window, and the instruction set's own practice for an unencodable adjunct is to leave it out and record the gap (sequence/scope adverbs, the "D-Ashford" tag) rather than coin or mis-slot a head; the remaining claim is entailed by the sentence, so this is the coverage gap the reviewer also filed, not a defect.

The "inflection only, never derivation" bar is stated for a word derived into another part of speech (coastal / mountainous / tidal), which a same-part-of-speech prefixed verb is not; `light` + (Again sk_light_1) is true of the sentence, well-typed, and asserts no prior event, and the reviewer's own gap entry concedes the instruction set does not decide the case.

gaps_confirmed: classificatory "V NP as NP/ADJ" secondary predicate ("recorded the incident as a minor weather event") — neither resultative nor depictive, and a flat typing atom would assert the Council's classification as fact, so no carrier exists
forward bounded window ("within the hour") — WithinLast is backward-only, TimeAtMost needs a time term, and BeforeBy states an exact gap rather than a bound
prefixal derivation on a verb ("relit", "reopen") — the instruction set does not say whether the lemma is `relight` or `light` + (Again …)
quantity/portion of-phrase ("a gust of wind") — excluded from Possession and not a stated-proportion partitive, so no head is assigned

mandative subjunctive complement ("recommended that the Council issue …") — the directive force has no carrier, since Directive/Forbid are imperative-only and a seal cannot hold a 0.7-strength Obligated on one conjunct

a definite superordinate NP anaphoric to a previously described event ("the incident") — the anaphoric-definite rule covers re-mention of a same-class witness, not a summary label, so the incident witness stays unlinked to the extinguishing
ordinal day-of-year in a non-Gregorian calendar ("day 410 of Year 2") — (Day n) is the day-of-month slot, so (Day 410) overloads it
new_gaps: an episodic negative-quantifier subject ("No wraith emerged" in a dated one-off narrative) — the faithful existential denial has no quantified range, and QuantifierPhrase may only restate a range the parse quantifies, so the surface word "no" is lost with no licensed carrier

an event-noun object of an attitude/record verb whose content is stated as a classification rather than a clause — with the object role filled by the entity, the classification has nowhere to attach even as a non-committal record
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant record clause is (Agent sk_record_1 sk_council_1) with (Theme sk_record_1 sk_incident_1) giving the stated direct object its role. The classificatory "as a minor weather event" has no licensed carrier of any kind, so it should be left unencoded and filed as a gap rather than smuggled into the Theme slot as a sealed proposition.
adjudication.notes: Coreference across the passage, the sealed recommendation (Possession restrictor and per-member rule inside, group typing / Cliff Path name / mire_essence genus projected out), and the strength-0 (Past (LocatedIn …)) denial are all correct. Three of the five filed issues mistake genuine coverage gaps — a forward window, a prefixal verb, and an episodic "no" — for parse defects.
